analysis: The code snippet decodes an EventMessage from a ParsableByteArray. The execution flow: read schemeIdUri via readNullTerminatedString and pass through checkNotNull; read value similarly; read durationMs and id via readUnsignedInt; copy remaining bytes via Arrays.copyOfRange; return new EventMessage. Potential runtime exceptions: (1) Assertions.checkNotNull may throw NullPointerException if ExoPlayerLibraryInfo.ASSERTIONS_ENABLED is true and the argument is null; this is intended as a development assertion and not for production handling. (2) readNullTerminatedString internally calls forName with a constant, so no exceptions. (3) Arrays.copyOfRange may throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, IllegalArgumentException, or NullPointerException, but preceding reads guarantee non-null data and valid indices. Thus, only checkNotNull poses a conditional runtime exception, but it does not require catching as it is an assertion. Therefore, no runtime exceptions need to be caught in this snippet.
